patch_description: Add a fixed-radius center-relaxation stage before the final joint polish.  The existing joint SLSQP solves can become locked into a locally rigid contact graph because every radius is already active.  Deflating the LP-optimal radii by a few percent creates geometric freedom; optimizing only centers with a short-range repulsive clearance energy then redistributes that freedom among near contacts and walls.  A subsequent full center/radius solve restores the radii and can exploit the changed contact graph.  Candidates are still scored by the exact fixed-center LP and undergo the existing final feasibility certification.
